```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggdag)
library(dagitty)

dag_4 <- dagify(
  shot_prob ~ defender_ability + offensive_team + shot_movement + shot_zone,
  
  defender_ability ~ defensive_skill + defensive_pressure + defensive_team,

  defensive_pressure ~ position + fouls,  # More fouls reduce defensive pressure
  
  outcome = "shot_prob",
  exposure = "fouls",
  labels = c(
    "shot_prob" = "Shot Making\nProbability",
    "offensive_team" = "Opposing\nOffense",
    "shot_movement" = "Shot\nType",
    "shot_zone" = "Shot\nLocation",
    "defender_ability" = "Defender\nAbility",
    "offense_quality" = "Offense\nQuality",
    "defensive_skill" = "Defensive\nSkill",
    "defensive_pressure" = "Defensive\nPressure",
    "position" = "Position",
    "defensive_team" = "Defensive\nTeam",
    "fouls" = "Accumulated\nFouls"
  )
)

# Plot dag_3 with improved readability and visual hierarchy
ggdag_parents(dag_4, "shot_prob") +
  theme_dag() +
  scale_color_hue(breaks = c("parent", "child")) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),  # Make legend keys smaller
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),  # Make legend text smaller
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),  # Reduce legend margins
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),  # Reduce space between legend and plot
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  scale_adjusted() +
  geom_dag_point(
      size = 20
  )+
  geom_dag_edges_link(edge_width = 1) +
  geom_dag_label(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 2,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold")
```
